name: rail-live-band-rows
description: rail Live band rows at the default 280px rail: a session row's second 'why' line never wraps (one caption line tall, truncating inside the row), a row with a why line starts its title at the same x as one without, and the why line sits under the title text rather than under the status dot

mutation.note: Without nowrap the long why text wraps and the .why box grows past one caption line.
